_about: The development school: roles, staff, who teaches what, and learners. Read by DevelopmentSchoolSeeder in local and testing only. Classes are named "Campus/Class"; scopes are "school", "campus:Name", "division:Name" or "class:Campus/Class". Staff get no password: use View as.

roles.name: Head teacher
roles.description: Leads a division: learners, registers and results.

roles.name: Academic officer
roles.description: Locks marks, keeps scales and grading plans, and watches registers.

roles.name: Admissions officer
roles.description: Admits learners and keeps their records.

roles.name: Subject teacher
roles.description: Teaches subjects: lesson registers, assessments and marks.

roles.name: Class teacher
roles.description: Keeps the morning register of one class.
